answer: Every claim climbs the signal of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the canyon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The yarrow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, clawed back after a replayed submission, rewards vest against future work. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
